cq_coverage.CQ1: The class TheatreFestival with the property takesPlaceDuring (xsd:gYearMonth) answers when a festival took place.
cq_coverage.CQ2: TheatreFestival and hasFestivalLocation (domain: TheatreFestival, range: City) answers where a festival took place.
cq_coverage.CQ3: TheatreFestival and featuresPlay (domain: TheatreFestival, range: Play) answers what plays could be seen during a festival.
cq_coverage.CQ4: Theatre and locatedInCity (domain: Theatre, range: City) answers in what city a theatre is located.
cq_coverage.CQ5: City and locatedInCountry (domain: City, range: Country) answers in what country a city is located.
cq_coverage.CQ6: Production and hasBasisPlay (domain: Production, range: Play) answers what play is the basis of a production.
cq_coverage.CQ7: Ensemble and hasMember (domain: Ensemble, range: Person), with Participation (pivot class) and participant/participationIn, allow tracking of ensemble membership at a point in time.
cq_coverage.CQ8: Play and writtenBy (domain: Play, range: Author) answers what plays a certain author wrote.
cq_coverage.CQ9: Play and writtenDuring (domain: Play, range: xsd:gYearRange) answers during what time period a play was written.
cq_coverage.CQ10: Play and hasNumberOfActs (domain: Play, range: xsd:integer) answers how many acts a play contains.
cq_coverage.CQ11: Production and hasPremiere (domain: Production, range: ProductionPremiere), with premiereDate (domain: ProductionPremiere, range: xsd:date) answers when the premier of a production was.
cq_coverage.CQ12: Review, reviewedBy (domain: Review, range: Newspaper), reviewOf (domain: Review, range: Production), and hasStarRating (domain: Review, range: StarRating) answer the star rating given by a newspaper for a production.
cq_coverage.CQ13: Employment (pivot class), employmentStartDate (domain: Employment, range: xsd:date), and employmentPerson (domain: Employment, range: Person) answer when an actor started working for a theatre.
cq_coverage.CQ14: RoleAssignment (pivot class), role (domain: RoleAssignment, range: Role), roleTimeSpan (domain: RoleAssignment, range: xsd:gYearMonth), participant/participationIn answer what roles a person has within a production at a point in time.
cq_coverage.CQ15: Production and hasPremiere (Functional property) enforce a production has exactly one premiere.
